role.label: Professor at Bochum – Bernard Andreae
role.note: Archeologist, professor at Bochum (1965-1977) and Marburg (1978-1985), and then Director of the German Archaeological Institute in Rome (1984-1995).

event.label: Excavation at Villa in Sperlonga – Bernard Andreae
event.note: In the 1970s and 1980s, he tracked the Rome Soprintendenza's excavations at Tiberius's Villa in Sperlonga, producing complex reconstructions of the Hellenistic-Roman sculpture groups.

work.title: new edition of the Alexander Mosaic
work.note: His contributions to Neue Forschungen in Pompeji (1974) and a new edition of the Alexander Mosaic (1977) reflect his focus on Roman painting and Late Republican/Early Imperial classicism.
